entities.name: Norreen
entities.description: Fighter wife of Garth One-Eye, born Rakel of the Benalish clan Tarmula.

entities.name: Garth One-Eye
entities.description: Wizard and planeswalker, husband of Norreen, who recanted his spark.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Dominarian nation with a caste system.

entities.name: Alaqua
entities.description: Warlord whose squire Norreen was; killed in battle.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: Leader Norreen was to assassinate but instead became his lover and commander.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: Place where Norreen recovered in a hospital.

entities.name: Gish
entities.description: Countryside where Norreen and Garth farmed a vineyard.

entities.name: Whispering Woods
entities.description: Place the army escaped to and Garth reappeared.

entities.name: Time of Troubles
entities.description: Period after which Garth promised to give up planeswalking.

events.summary: Norreen chooses to become a hero above Benalia's caste system, serving as squire to the warlord Alaqua.
events.quote: she served as squire to the warlord Alaqua

events.summary: In the Red Iron Mountains Alaqua is killed and Norreen badly wounded; she recovers in Estark for fourteen months and chooses to fight in the Arena.
events.quote: Alaqua was killed, and Norreen was struck by three arrows

events.summary: Norreen meets Garth in the Arena and falls in love; he promises to give up planeswalking and they retire to Gish with Hammen.
events.quote: Here she met Garth, whom she quickly fell in love with.

events.summary: Norreen and Hammen are kidnapped and taken to Benalia while Garth is away.
events.quote: Norreen and Hammen were kidnapped and brought to Benalia

events.summary: Norreen becomes Gull's lover and army commander, then attempts suicide, is tortured and saved by Lily and Gull.
events.quote: She was captured and tortured before being saved by Lily and Gull.

events.summary: Garth reappears, recants his planeswalker spark and returns to the vineyard with his family.
events.quote: The wizard recanted his planeswalker spark
